lines.text: Everyone who believes Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and loving God means keeping His commandments.
The victory that has overcome the world is our faith, and only he who believes Jesus is the Son of God overcomes.
Jesus Christ came by water and fire, and the Spirit testifies to this because the Spirit is the truth.
The Spirit, the water, and the blood agree, and whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a stranger.
God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
